commands.description: List of belenios-tool command invocations (e.g., 'belenios-tool election create --public-key /etc/belenios/public.pem') — one string per list item. Each item is a full command invocation line, as would be used in scripts or CI/CD. No validation is performed on command syntax beyond being a string; the user must ensure correctness per 'belenios-tool COMMAND --help'.
